The 5 Code Families RPSC Uses

1️⃣ Uniform shift — every letter moves by the same amount: CAT +2 → ECV. Find the shift from ONE letter pair; apply to all.
2️⃣ Incremental shift — steps grow letter by letter: CAT (+1,+2,+3) → DCW. Check the 1st pair, then verify the gap grows.
3️⃣ Reverse alphabet (Atbash) — A↔Z, B↔Y… position 27−n: CAT → XZG. Suspect it when codes look "opposite".
4️⃣ Word rearrangement — letters reverse or swap pairs: CAT → TAC, MANGO → AMGNO. The code uses the SAME letters — that's the giveaway.
5️⃣ Position numbers — letters become numbers: CAT → 3-1-20, or summed: CAT → 24. Watch for ×2, +4 style tweaks.
💡 Strategy: compare just the FIRST letter pair — 80% of codes reveal their family immediately. Then verify with the second.
